verdict.rationale: LangSmith's docs say you can host an instance in your own infrastructure, with Helm-based tuning for self-hosted deployments. That gives you control over where trace and evaluation data lives. Nothing in the evidence describes choosing a region (e.g., US/EU) for the managed cloud, so residency control appears to require running and operating it yourself. Missing for 10: managed-cloud region/residency selection, explicit data-residency documentation, independent corroboration of self-hosted data control.
